item.description: ⚠️ MANUAL GATE — Wait for HPBC callbacks before running. Run 1 is discovery: observe the terminal status logged in C1, then lock C1b for repeatable runs.

## Order Fulfilment Flow Test

Tests the full order lifecycle: creation → draft fields → Stripe checkout → payment → PDF render → HPBC cascade → terminal state.

---

### Before each run

Set these collection variables:

| Variable | Value |
|---|---|
| `instantStoriesId` | The `instant_stories` record id for this order (set automatically if running from folder 1 → 2 → 3) |
| `testProductId` | `3` = TOM-001, `4` = TOM-002 |
| `authToken_user2` | A second test-mode user's JWT (3A-3c only) |

Shipping fields (`shippingName`, `shippingAdd1`, etc.) are pre-filled with defaults — update if needed.

---

### Run matrix — run once per staging SKU

| # | `test_mode` (user flag) | `pdf_force_success` (env) | Proves |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | true | true | Full chain on a known-good doc — cheap, no Papermill spend |
| 2 | true | false | Go-live proof — real Papermill PDFs clear HPBC preflight |

> ⚠️ Both runs use a `test_mode = true` user. Never run from this harness with a live-SKU user.

---

### Sub-folders

| Folder | Gate | What it covers |
|---|---|---|
| **3A. Pre-payment smoke test** | Synchronous — runs straight through | Order creation, draft patch, Stripe session, session persistence, ownership enforcement |
| **3B. Payment & confirmation** | ⚠️ Manual — trigger payment first | Stripe payment simulation + confirmation that Stripe registered it |
| **3C. PDFs + cascade** | ⚠️ Manual — wait for PDF worker tick | PDF attachment assertions + HPBC cascade proof |
| **3D. HPBC terminal state** | ⚠️ Manual — wait for HPBC callbacks | Terminal order status, HPBC update records, webhook events |

---

### Go-live sequence (Pureprint)

1. Clean run on both staging SKUs (TOM-001, TOM-002) using this harness → notify Alex at Pureprint with the `order_number` of each test order.
2. One order per live SKU → full end-to-end live test (real print, real cost).
3. Production opens.

item.name: 5B-2 · GET /characters — favourites first, public fields only

exec: pm.test("test character is present and favourited", () => {
const c = list.find(x => x.id === id); pm.expect(c, "test character").to.exist; pm.expect(c.is_favourite).to.eql(true);
pm.test("every character is archived", () => list.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("archived")));
pm.test("test character is listed", () => pm.expect(list.some(c => c.id === id)).to.be.true);
pm.test("every character is active", () => list.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.status).to.eql("active")));
pm.test("archived test character is not listed", () => pm.expect(list.some(c => c.id === id)).to.be.false);
